findings.motion: HB 958 Election Law Changes, Second Reading (RCS 758, 66 aye, 47 no)
findings.note: Voted aye on second reading of HB 958, Election Law Changes. The bill digest describes changes to voter list maintenance, audit and challenge of votes cast by ineligible voters, a temporary moratorium on expiration of certain Class C drivers licenses used for photo ID, and a requirement that voter registration staff stop an application when the applicant says they are not a citizen or declines to answer.
subjects: photo ID at the polls (licence validity)

findings.motion: HB 834 State Board of Elections Administrative Changes, M11 Concur (RCS 800, 74 aye, 35 no)
findings.note: Voted aye to concur on HB 834. The digest says the bill gives a voter more time (to noon on the fifth business day after an election) to provide ID when ID numbers do not match or after voting a provisional ballot for lack of photo ID, and treats certain Class C drivers licenses as valid and unexpired for the photo ID rule. Digest: https://webservices.ncleg.gov/BillDigests/2025/H834.

findings.motion: HB 958 Election Law Changes, Second Reading
findings.note: Roll-call on HB 958, Election Law Changes (bill page https://www.ncleg.gov/BillLookUp/2025/H958; ratified text https://www.ncleg.gov/Sessions/2025/Bills/House/PDF/H958v9.pdf). The ratified bill says a voter registration application, including one taken at a drivers license office, is processed only if the applicant affirmatively states US citizenship; an applicant who leaves the question blank gets a notice and has 30 days to return a statement under penalty of perjury. It also requires the State Board of Elections to set up a process to remove voters flagged as non-citizens in a federal database, and adds cross-state and death-record voter-roll checks. It does not add a photo ID rule or a document requirement. The Governor vetoed it on 2026-08-17; the bill page shows no override vote yet. Stage voted on: House second reading.
subjects: proof of citizenship to register (statement of citizenship on registration form)
